name: get_campus_day
description: Return confirmed Campus agenda events for one specific calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). An empty result means no confirmed agenda event for that date; do not infer one from the recurring weekly schedule. Includes live-clock academicContext from the curated KIT PUCP calendar registry. Use referenceWeek and explicit section labels before choosing current materials; use referenceDate for a future class. If calendarRegistration.required is true, refresh the registry with get_academic_calendar and report a missing term honestly; use set_academic_calendar only as a temporary local fallback.

forceRefresh.description: Queue a metadata-only refresh while returning the last good cache.

referenceDate.description: Optional target class date for material matching; does not replace the current server date.
